about: The secreta of the formulary “Palm Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that the gift offered before the eyes of Thy majesty may obtain for us the grace of devotion and gain the fruit of blessed eternity. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
